reviews.author: chirag prajapati
reviews.text:
We have recently completed our Himachal tour with Suzu. Had wonderful experience with suzu travels from Chandigarh Shimla,manali dharmshala , delhjousi and Amritsar .So thanks Gopal thakur  speciallly they arranged pure veg restaurant and hotels.  The driver Rushi thakuer thanks for nice and comfortable journey with ten days.
In the end last stay in amritsar we face uncomfortable hotel and food. So i will rate 1 star for amritsar hotel and food.
Suggest you to provide familier hotel in amritsar.

reviews.author: drlucky prajapat
reviews.text:
DR. LUCKY: Dear Suzu Travel Team,

Our trip has been completed successfully, and we would like to express our heartfelt thanks to the entire team. Everything was well-organized, comfortable, and enjoyable throughout the journey.

Your excellent planning, support, and attention to detail made this trip a truly memorable experience for all of us.

Thank you once again for your wonderful service. We look forward to traveling with you again in the future.

Best wishes and sincere gratitude from all of us.
साथ ही हमारी यात्रा को यादगार बनाने के लिए हमारे driver परवेज भाई का बहुत-बहुत धन्यवाद। उनका व्यवहार बेहद विनम्र, सहयोगी और प्रोफेशनल रहा। पूरे सफर में उन्होंने सुरक्षित और आरामदायक ड्राइविंग की, साथ ही हर परिस्थिति में पूरा सहयोग दिया। पहाड़ी रास्तों पर उनका अनुभव और धैर्य काबिले-तारीफ है। ऐसे जिम्मेदार और मित्रवत driver के साथ यात्रा करना सच में शानदार अनुभव रहा। धन्यवाद!

reviews.author: Kumar Sourabh
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ "First time Kerala trip ka best experience raha!
"Humne Durgapur-Kolkata se Cochin aur Kanyakumari tak ka pura Kerala tour Suzu Travels ke sath book kiya tha. Unki communication aur customer guidance bilkul exceptional thi! Personalized service aur expert advice ne pure safar ko bohot smooth bana diya. Aisa laga jaise hum bilkul safe aur sahi hatho mein hain. Suzu Travels team aur hamare cab driver ka bohot bohot shukriya hamari is trip ko zindagi ka sabse yaadgar experience banane ke liye. Highly recommended!

reviews.text: Best travel agency.. They keep their promises and provide exactly what they commit. Suzu travels gave us best service in affordable prices.. Thanks Mr. Sohel who Deals with us like a family... Hope will came again with u..thank you again

All the hotels in Amritsar,Dal housie, and Dharmshala provided by them were excellent with good locations and services .

reviews.author: Neelam Kumari
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Suzu Travels ke saath Manali ka trip kaafi organized aur memorable raha, aur main inki professionalism aur hospitality se behad impressed hoon. Shuruat se hi booking process kaafi smooth tha aur team ne hamari pasand ke hisaab se ek behtareen itinerary plan ki thi. Humein jo hotels allot kiye gaye wo kaafi hygienic aur amazing mountain views ke saath the, aur wahan ka staff bhi kaafi courteous tha. Sabse acchi baat ye rahi ki hamare driver kaafi experienced aur punctual the, jis wajah se Himachal ke hilly terrain mein humein kaafi safe aur comfortable feel hua. Trip ke dauran bhi Suzu Travels ki team lagatar hamare touch mein rahi taaki humein koi inconvenience na ho. Agar aap Himachal Pradesh ke liye ek genuine aur reliable travel partner dhoond rahe hain jo value-for-money services de, toh main Suzu Travels ko strongly recommend karti hoon. Thanks to the entire team for making our vacation so special! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.author: Simran Tambe
reviews.text:
Had a wonderful experience with suzu travels. We had a trip starting from Delhi-Shimla-Manali-Dharamshala-Dalhousie-Amritsar. The experience was very nice. Our pilot Vikas Thakur, is the best support of the team, very experienced driver, and very corporative person. Ashiya Ma'am supported us even at minute inconveniences. And Gopal Thakur's guidance and alignment with the itenary is impeccable.
Thanks a lot Suzu travels for making our first time Himachal trip the best experience our lives.

reviews.author: TARUN JAISWAL
reviews.text: સુઝુ ટ્રેવલ્સ ને ધન્યવાદ આપવો છે કે તેમે શિમલા મણાલી પર સર્વોત્તમ ટૂર પેકેજ અને સેવા પ્રદાન કર્યો છે. મારી કુટુંબનો અને મિત્રોનો આ પર્યટન યાત્રા યાદગાર અને આનંદકારી બન્યો છે. તમારી વત્સલતા અને સહીષ્ણુતા સાથે સુઝુ ટ્રેવલ્સ ને મળેલી સેવા માટે આભાર.

reviews.author: Milind Karalkar
reviews.text: "सुझू ट्रॅव्हल्सला मी शिमला-मनाली यात्रेची सर्वोत्तम आयोजन करण्याची प्रशंसा करू इच्छितो. त्यांनी माझ्या परिवारासाठी एक अद्वितीय अनुभव प्रदान केला. त्यांच्या नेतृत्वाखाली आणि संचयित योजनेबद्दल माझ्या आवश्यकतांच्या सर्वांच्या आत्मीयता आणि सुगमतेच्या साथीला मिळालं. शिमला आणि मनालीतील अद्वितीय पर्यटन स्पोट्सला आपल्याला आपल्या आपल्या यात्रेच्या योजनेत आणि बजेटमध्ये समाविष्ट केलं. सुझू ट्रॅव्हल्सच्या सेवांची गुणवत्ता आणि उत्कृष्ट व्यवस्थापनाच्या सर्व आदर्शांची पालन केली आहे. माझ्याला ही यात्रा सदैव स्मरणीय अनुभव ठरवली आहे, आणि मी सुझू ट्रॅव्हल्सला माझ्या मित्रांना आणि कुटुंबाला शिमला-मनाली यात्रेसाठी सूचवू. धन्यवाद, सुझू ट्रॅव्हल्स, तुमच्या सेवांसाठी!"
